summary: OceanLight Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company trading on Nasdaq (OCLTU), filed an 8-K announcing that, with underwriter consent, holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying ordinary shares, rights and warrants beginning on or about September 10-11, 2026. Separated ordinary shares, rights (each exchangeable for one-fourth of a share), and warrants (exercisable at $11.50) are expected to list on the Nasdaq Capital Market under OCLT, OCLTR and OCLTW; unseparated units continue as OCLTU. Continental Stock Transfer & Trust is transfer agent; no deal terms or target were disclosed. Watch for a business combination announcement and trust redemption dynamics.
